summary: Checked the production build fix (@types/node@^20 plus tsconfig types ['vite/client','node']). In an isolated copy (/tmp/x: /app/frontend without node_modules/build) `yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build` exited 0 with 0 'error TS'. tsc passed, vite built, and build/index.html plus assets were produced. A second run with a fresh empty YARN_CACHE_FOLDER (true clean install) also passed. yarn.lock pins @types/node 20.19.43. Smoke test on the preview URL passed: landing page loads, Create Room reaches /lobby/XMNVS, Fill bots added 5 bots (6/10, quorum), START GAME shows the role reveal (Government MP) with game-screen and parliament-canvas present, and there were no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: The vite.config.ts/tsconfig change is correct and minimal. Optional: the Join page name/room-code inputs and the Create Room/Join buttons have no data-testid.
seed_data_creation: None. One ephemeral in-memory room (host TEST_Smoke + 5 bots) closes when the browser disconnects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build check recipe: copy /app/frontend minus node_modules/build to a tmp dir, run yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build, and check build/index.html. The isolated copy was deleted after testing.
rca of the issue: vite.config.ts imports 'node:url' and uses process.env, and tsconfig includes vite.config.ts. Without @types/node in devDependencies and in compilerOptions.types, tsc fails with TS2307/TS2591. Adding both resolves it.
